ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Feedback: Using his X-ray vision or telepathy will quickly give Monaghan a headache, and will eventually proceed through nausea to cause him more physical pain. Morals: Tommy Monaghan’s sense of morality keeps him from ever being an utterly irredeemable villain, but in the bloody and corrupt world in which he operates, it’s also often a frustrating limitation. Marked for Death: Tommy Monaghan has many, many enemies, most of whom want him dead.
